title: Configure the render merge driver in one step

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S109 points `render/` at a `slicer-generated` merge driver in `.gitattributes`, but the driver name only resolves once each clone runs two `git config` lines. When it is not configured, every merge writes conflict markers into (or blends) the large ROADMAP files, and the merge then needs a manual `slicer render` -- this happened on every merge in this project's recent work. Nothing surfaces the one-time setup, and slicer's git allowlist forbids `git config`, so slicer cannot run it for the user.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py` (`cmd_init`, or a small setup command)
- `README.md` and `docs/getting-started.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `slicer init` output names the exact two `git config merge.slicer-generated.*` lines a clone runs once.
2. slicer still never executes `git config` (the vcs allowlist is unchanged).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Surface the two `git config` lines where a person will see them: from `slicer init` (and the docs), or a dedicated `slicer setup-git` that prints -- does not run -- them. Do not add `config` to the vcs allowlist. Decide with the project whether `init` prints always or only inside a git repo, and whether to also hint at them when a render file conflicts.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `slicer init` names the two lines; the suite and `slicer check` pass; a clone that runs them merges `render/` without markers (as S109's tests show).

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit. Do not tag or push.
